design_premises_found_false: P1: design §6 XA2 (b) 'the POST is 422' is false: R9 (the body's digest) precedes R11, so a consistently forged card's POST is 409 Conflict 'the request changed since the card was shown'; XA2 asserts 409 and 0 rows (T4's own R9 sentence agrees)

P2: design §2.7 step 5 'then re-reads /surface/requests/{id}': the card JSON carries no recorded approval (RT3), so the page shows the POST's answer; the outcome-unknown status check reads requests.json's recorded; a later open shows used

P3: design §6's driver commands: grantNotifications/notify move with XA4 (the cut); click exists as an internal helper so the command is press; openCard, waitFor, credential, fill, save, card are added
